text: 中国人民银行统计，2026年二季度末，金融机构人民币各项贷款余额282.63万亿元，同比增长5.2%，上半年人民币贷款增加10.72万亿元。2026年二季度末，本外币企事业单位贷款余额197.47万亿元，同比增长8.2%，增速比各项贷款高3.1个百分点，上半年增加11.26万亿元。分期限看，短期贷款及票据融资余额69.68万亿元，同比增长12.3%，上半年增加5.53万亿元。中长期贷款余额123.93万亿元，同比增长6.1%，上半年增加5.54万亿元。分用途看，固定资产贷款余额79.27万亿元，同比增长3.2%，上半年增加2万亿元。经营性贷款余额83.2
text_en: The PBOC reported that at the end of Q2 2026, financial institutions' total RMB loans stood at 282.63 trillion yuan, up 5.2% year-on-year, with an increase of 10.72 trillion yuan in H1. At the end of Q2 2026, domestic and foreign currency loans to enterprises and public institutions totaled 197.47 trillion yuan, up 8.2% year-on-year, 3.1 percentage points higher than total loan growth, with an increase of 11.26 trillion yuan in H1. By maturity, short-term loans and bill financing were 69.68 trillion yuan, up 12.3% year-on-year, with an increase of 5.53 trillion yuan in H1. Medium- and long-term loans were 123.93 trillion yuan, up 6.1% year-on-year, with an increase of 5.54 trillion yuan in H1.
